evals.prompt: Run a controlled comparison while helping me draft a 700-word incident retrospective for a mixed technical and nontechnical audience. Use the fixed Planning, Translating, then Reviewing order and keep the same .writing state across passes.
evals.expected_output: The run follows the fixed process order, delegates the shared roles, preserves the hierarchical goal network, and records every process switch with evidence and uncertainty.
expectations: Starts each pass with Planning, then moves to Translating and Reviewing.
Keeps the prescribed order even when a role report recommends another process, and stops only after a Reviewing pass.
Updates hierarchical goals and records goal changes without changing the assignment.
